title: Throne Method Grand Cycle Showcase
address: South Bank Parklands, South Brisbane QLD 4101
summary: A showcase of Brisbane's local cycling talent — races, rider meet-and-greets and a chance to connect with the team.
about: Join us at South Bank for an afternoon of racing featuring the Throne Method squad and local up-and-comers. Bring the family, meet the riders and see what the Method is all about.

title: Cycling Team Celebration Gala Night
summary: Celebrate the achievements of Throne Method Racing with an evening of food, drinks, and fun.
about: Meet the cyclists, enjoy live music, and take part in our charity raffle. An evening of celebration with Throne Method Racing.

title: Beginner Cycling Skills Workshop
summary: A free workshop for youths and adults, led by Throne Method cyclists.
about: Learn the fundamentals — bike handling, group riding etiquette and road safety — from the Throne Method squad. Free for all ages and abilities.
